decay: read-time weighting owned by #275 (clean-conduct weeks; restitution repairs directly) — deeds are never deleted, so a forgiven past stays auditable

effectsByGroupClass.dojosLeague: #242 crowd warmth; #244 challenge customs; #133 trial framing (never the verdict)
effectsByGroupClass.syndicateUnderworld: valence swaps — town infamy is Syndicate fame; the group record declares its own reading
effectsByGroupClass.towns: #118 terms beyond morale's personal prices; #164 custody-work trust; after-dark doors (#119 presentation)

groups: world data (towns, dojos, regions, services, the Syndicate) — classes specified here, instances authored with the world; zero instanced
note: FNV reputation pulled in 100% per the owner's direction — fame and infamy as separate tallies is the core insight, kept whole. Deep documentation in RESEARCH-SOURCES.md. Supersedes #201's model: its classes become a view over this ladder (STAGING step 5); its derived-never-stored and never-currency laws are inherited.

read.combination: standing is a NAMED COMBINATION of the fame band x the infamy band (FNV's sixteen standing names are this shape), placed on #271's ladder as a coordinate — never an arithmetic difference
read.hatedFloor: once infamy reaches the group's hate threshold (data, scaled to group size, FNV-style), the group never reads the Ranger Unmarked again; the best road back is mixed, then liked-with-a-past — via #275 deeds + time, never by fame outscoring infamy
read.law: fame and infamy NEVER cancel; a zero with tall stories on both sides is NOT the same social fact as never having been heard of
read.mixedFlag: both tallies high — FNV's both-piles-high case: the group holds two true stories; behaviour is helped-and-wary, welcomed-and-watched (#271 draft prefix: Two-Storied)

tallies.discipline: derived at read time from #269's deed ledger filtered by #272 witness/report facts — never stored
tallies.fame: 0..25 per group per Ranger — witnessed good credited to that group
tallies.groupCredit: data on the deed (which groups a witnessed deed reaches, and to which tally — stealing FROM the Syndicate, witnessed by a town, may credit the town's fame)
tallies.infamy: 0..25 per group per Ranger — witnessed bad credited to that group

vsMorale: reputation is built ONLY from witnessed/reported facts; an unseen deed moves #269 morale and nothing here
